answer: Slashable vouching makes each extra identity pay one voucher staking 0.125 ETH; a farm running N fakes pays N×0.125 ETH and cannot share it: one voucher backs exactly one newcomer and a caught fake slashes the voucher too. A newcomer finds a voucher in the garden of members, posts video proof, and waits 7 days while challengers earn the slashed stake as nectar. A farm reusing one voucher dies by joint-slash audit at 2: the second clone flags the voucher and burns both stakes, and the caught fake logs as a comet before its seat is struck.
